common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: approval concept sheet for SpaceTrader 2D game. Match the supplied references: mature hand-drawn painted European sci-fi comic, strong dark ink contours, curved rounded engineering, weathered cream enamel and teal with brass, warm amber lights, rich painterly shading and meticulous readable details. NOT vector icons, NOT low-poly, NOT photorealistic.

sheets.prompt: Make a landscape approval sheet with exactly 8 equal panels in a 4 columns x 2 rows layout on dark navy. Each panel shows ONE complete spherical planet, generously separated, lit upper left, natural dark ink silhouette, NO atmospheric rim, detailed inked curved continental surface. Small neat cream German caption below each. Row 1: AGRARWELT (patchwork ochre and green farmland, tiny teal farm cities); OZEANWELT (deep blue ocean, swirling currents, tiny brass offshore platforms); WÜSTENWELT (warm dunes, canyon scars, tiny domed oasis); BERGBAUWELT (rust rocky globe, enormous excavations and mineral seams). Row 2: EISWELT (icy blue fissures, polar glaciers, tiny sheltered outposts); METROPOLE (dense cream-teal city network over curved globe, amber night lights); PARADIESWELT (turquoise tropical seas, emerald islands and resort clusters); GASRIESE (rich sweeping cream, teal and ochre cloud bands with great storm). No ships, no UI, no grids over the objects. Every globe similar size, spherical not flat landscapes. CRITICAL USER CORRECTION: NO blue ring, NO cyan outline, NO glowing atmospheric halo around ANY planet. Planet edge is a crisp inked natural silhouette against dark navy. Globe itself may have blue oceans, but no blue outer border.

Landscape concept sheet exactly 5 equal panels, 3 on top and 2 centered below. Dark navy background. Complete spherical planets lit upper left, strong inked contours, natural inked edges without atmosphere glow and comfortable margin, each caption below. DSCHUNGELWELT: lush dark emerald canopy, immense river systems, cloud wisps. VULKANWELT: charcoal cracked crust with glowing lava and sulfur teal lakes. KOLONIE: blue-green sparsely settled globe, one tiny youthful cream and teal settlement. INDUSTRIEWELT: rugged smoky copper globe with big industrial cities, linked teal machinery and amber networks. RUINENWELT: muted moss green globe with weathered sandstone ancient city ruins and overgrown aqueduct arcs, small recovering teal settlement. Show distinct clear globe silhouettes, not cross sections, no closeup surface landscapes. CRITICAL USER CORRECTION: NO blue ring, NO cyan outline, NO luminous atmospheric halo around any globe. Crisp natural inked edge.

Landscape approval sheet, exactly 6 panels 3 columns x 2 rows, dark navy background, generous spacing, one isolated orbital structure per panel, elevated three-quarter view, complete object no cropping. German captions. WERFT: compact U-shaped curved repair cradle with one tiny ship under construction, orange crane arms. GROSSE WERFT: massive double drydock with two long bays, ribbed gantries and cranes. FRAKTIONSWERFT: fortified shipyard with dark teal curved shields, purple accents and insignia-free banners. HANDELS-HUB: large bustling radial market station with rounded central dome and six detailed cargo piers. ORBITALHOTEL: elegant circular habitat ring with warm panoramic windows and botanical glass domes. AUSSENPOSTEN: compact rugged three-arm frontier ring with communications mast and modest habitat modules. Distinct functional silhouettes, no planet, no surrounding ships except tiny construction hulls in drydocks.

Landscape approval sheet exactly 7 panels in 4 columns top, 3 centered bottom, dark navy background. Whole isolated objects in elevated three-quarter view, generous margin and labels. TIEFENMINE: asteroid-integrated drilling station with enormous brass drill jaws and ore hoppers. ANTIMATERIE-LABOR: rounded scientific station containing a violet luminous orb inside containment hoops. NEBELGAS-SAMMLER: station with broad funnel scoops, mesh sails and pink gas collection vessels. BERGUNGSWRACK: broken old freighter hull with exposed ribs and torn teal plates, no fire. ARCHIVSTELLE: ancient enclosed sandstone and bronze orbital repository, concentric sealed vault with cyan glyph-like light strips (no legible writing). STUDIENFUNDSTELLE: compact derelict research pod with a visible protected data capsule and broken dish. RELIKTWRACK: very ancient curved human spacecraft fragment with mysterious amber sealed core and patinated copper. Every subject visually distinct.

Landscape approval sheet exactly SIX panels 3 columns x 2 rows, stages numbered 1 to 6 with German labels. This is the SAME complete spherical moss green and blue planet with IDENTICAL geography, camera, lighting, coastlines, ancient sandstone aqueduct and broken tower landmarks in all six views, increasing construction progressively. Dark navy backdrop. NO blue rings, NO cyan edge outline, NO atmospheric glow, NO orbital ring at any stage. Natural inked silhouette. Housing and infrastructure follow globe curvature. Stage 1 ANKUNFT: almost entirely overgrown sandstone ruins, only 3 tiny inhabited cream houses with terracotta roofs, small landing clearing. Stage 2 SIEDLUNG: same ruins, 12 clustered houses, repaired well and farm plots. Stage 3 GEMEINDE: same globe, 35 houses, restored aqueduct segment, workshops and small teal utility domes, visible road connection. Stage 4 STADT: same globe, 100 houses across several districts, repaired bridges, factories and greenhouse domes, visibly greater coverage. Stage 5 GROSSSTADT: same globe, 250 houses, many connected cream terracotta districts, teal industrial precinct and expanded spaceport; landmarks preserved. Stage 6 WIEDERAUFGEBAUTE WELT: same globe, dense flourishing continent-wide settlement with 600 tiny houses and urban districts, restored ancient aqueducts and sandstone towers, advanced teal-and-brass industry and spaceport, still plenty of green forest and ocean. Make six strongly distinct ascending densities, preserve exact same globe contours and colors. Houses should read as painted tiny architecture, not scattered glowing rectangles. No UI or arrows, only stage captions below each planet.

NO ground, NO scenery, NO planets. Stations are rounded interconnected pressure vessels, docking collars and radiator fins, NOT terrestrial buildings pasted on a ground tile. Every station has a distinctive industrial function expressed in silhouette. Clear cream German caption below each object, spelled exactly. Left to right row by row: 1. WASSERWERK: twin teal spherical water tanks, icy intake hopper and curved purification pipes; 2. NAHRUNGSFABRIK: glass greenhouse dome with grain silos and food packaging modules; 3. TREIBSTOFFDEPOT: six cream cylindrical fuel tanks with orange pipes and refuelling arms; 4. RAFFINERIE: tall curved distillation columns with amber fluid chambers; 5. SCHMELZWERK: glowing orange enclosed furnace, ore hopper and metal casting trough; 6. ÖLWERK: black fluid vessels, brass hydraulic pumping pistons; 7. KUNSTSTOFFWERK: rounded chemical pods and extrusion coils; 8. GLASHÜTTE: molten amber glass furnace, stacks of turquoise glass sheets; 9. CHEMIEFABRIK: colorful sealed reaction globes and winding copper tubing; 10. SILIZIUMWERK: crystal feed bin, clean silver processing chamber; 11. WEBEREI: visible cloth rolls and giant enclosed spool drums; 12. DÜNGERWERK: biomass digesters, green nutrient tanks and sealed sack loading bay. Maintain coherent weathered cream/teal/brass comic style but varied silhouettes, no extra panels.
